rules.name: Real-time Inventory Consistency
rules.statement: The system must prevent any order assignment if the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot indicates insufficient quantity for all requested items.
rules.condition: during order allocation to a store
rules.if_violated: The order is rejected and flagged for manual review to prevent overselling and revenue loss.
rules.rationale: Overselling leads to failed deliveries, customer dissatisfaction, and financial penalties.

parameters.name: minimum_available_quantity
parameters.description: the required stock level for each item in the order

rules.name: Discrepancy Investigation Threshold
rules.statement: The system must automatically trigger a Discrepancy Alert when the difference between physical stock counts and system records exceeds the configured tolerance limit.
rules.condition: during periodic inventory reconciliation or upon manual count upload
rules.if_violated: The discrepancy is logged, and the store partner is notified to initiate a physical audit before further sales of that SKU.
rules.rationale: Early detection of data drift prevents compounding errors and ensures accurate availability data.

parameters.name: tolerance_limit
parameters.description: the maximum allowed variance between physical and digital counts

rules.name: Overselling Incident Escalation
rules.statement: The system must escalate any confirmed overselling incident to the Compliance Officer immediately, regardless of the order status.
rules.condition: when an overselling event is confirmed via audit or customer dispute
rules.if_violated: The incident is recorded as a compliance breach, and the store partner's settlement is held pending investigation.
rules.rationale: Overselling represents a critical failure of trust and regulatory risk that requires immediate senior oversight.

parameters.name: escalation_priority
parameters.description: the urgency level assigned to the incident

rules.name: Partial Fulfillment Restriction
rules.statement: The system must not allow an order to proceed with partial fulfillment unless the customer explicitly consents to a split shipment.
rules.condition: when inventory is insufficient for the full order but sufficient for some items
rules.if_violated: The order is held in a pending state until full inventory is available or the customer cancels.
rules.rationale: Splitting orders without consent creates confusion, delays, and potential revenue loss due to partial cancellations.

parameters.name: split_shipment_threshold
parameters.description: the minimum percentage of items required to trigger a split option

rules.name: Unit Economics Threshold
rules.statement: The system must prevent the initiation of a new delivery route or order batch if the projected unit economics (revenue minus operational costs) falls below the minimum profitability threshold.
rules.condition: when calculating projected profitability for a route or order batch
rules.if_violated: The system blocks the allocation of orders to that route and alerts the Financial Controller for manual review and threshold adjustment.
rules.rationale: To prevent the accumulation of losses on specific routes that could erode overall platform margins and threaten financial sustainability.

parameters.name: minimum_profitability_threshold
parameters.description: The minimum acceptable profit margin or absolute profit per unit/order

rules.name: Commission Cap Enforcement
rules.statement: The system must not apply a transaction commission rate that exceeds the maximum cap defined in the active Store Partner Agreement for that specific merchant category.
rules.condition: when calculating revenue share for a transaction
exceptions: Force majeure events requiring temporary rate renegotiation
rules.if_violated: The transaction settlement is automatically halted, and the system flags the calculation for immediate manual audit and correction.
rules.rationale: To ensure strict adherence to contractual obligations and prevent legal disputes or loss of merchant trust due to overcharging.

parameters.name: maximum_commission_cap
parameters.description: The highest allowable commission percentage for a specific merchant category

rules.name: Real-Time Cost Variance Alert
rules.statement: The system must generate an immediate high-priority alert whenever the actual operational cost of a completed delivery deviates from the estimated cost by more than the allowed variance percentage.
rules.condition: upon finalization of a delivery and reconciliation of actual costs
exceptions: System-wide fuel price surges declared by the logistics provider
rules.if_violated: The system logs the anomaly, suspends further automated settlements for that specific delivery partner until the variance is explained, and notifies the Logistics Coordinator.
rules.rationale: To enable rapid identification of inefficiencies, fraud, or routing errors that impact the cost structure of the gig-economy model.

parameters.name: allowed_variance_percentage
parameters.description: The maximum acceptable percentage difference between estimated and actual costs

rules.name: Minimum Order Value Validation
rules.statement: The system must reject an Order Request submission if the sum of item prices is strictly less than the minimum order value dynamically retrieved from the Store Partner Agreement.
rules.condition: at the moment of Order Request submission
exceptions: Promotional codes explicitly overriding the minimum order value in the agreement
rules.if_violated: The system displays a clear error message to the Customer and prevents the Order Request from being submitted to the store.
rules.rationale: To ensure orders are economically viable for the store partner and cover the baseline operational costs of picking and packing.

parameters.name: minimum_order_value
parameters.description: The lowest total value allowed for an order before submission

rules.name: Real-Time Inventory Deduction
rules.statement: The system must immediately deduct reserved quantities from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot upon automatic order assignment.
rules.condition: when an order is automatically assigned to a Store Partner
rules.if_violated: The business risks overselling items and incurring immediate refund liabilities.
rules.rationale: Preventing overselling ensures accurate inventory representation and protects customer trust.

parameters.name: reservation_timeout
parameters.description: maximum duration a reservation holds inventory before release

rules.name: Revenue Share Accuracy
rules.statement: The system must calculate the revenue share percentage for a Financial Transaction Record using the pre-defined commission rate applicable to the specific Store Partner category.
rules.condition: when finalizing a Financial Transaction Record
rules.if_violated: The business faces financial disputes, regulatory non-compliance, and partner churn.
rules.rationale: Ensuring precise financial distribution maintains trust and adheres to contractual obligations.

parameters.name: commission_rate
parameters.description: percentage of transaction value allocated to the Platform Operator

rules.name: Performance Metric Threshold
rules.statement: A Store Partner may only maintain active status if their calculated quality score remains above the minimum acceptable threshold.
rules.condition: when generating the Real-Time Store Partner Performance Dashboard
rules.if_violated: The partner is restricted from receiving new orders until performance improves.
rules.rationale: Maintains service quality standards and protects the customer experience.

parameters.name: minimum_quality_score
parameters.description: lowest acceptable score to retain active status

rules.name: Settlement Timing
rules.statement: Financial settlement funds must not be transferred to the Store Partner until a valid Delivery Proof is recorded and verified.
rules.condition: when initiating the Financial Settlement Handover confirmation
rules.if_violated: The business risks paying for undelivered goods and losing revenue control.
rules.rationale: Ensures funds are only released upon successful fulfillment of the service obligation.

parameters.name: settlement_delay_window
parameters.description: maximum time allowed between proof verification and fund transfer

rules.name: Settlement Accuracy Requirement
rules.statement: A financial settlement record must include item costs, delivery fees, taxes, platform commissions, and net settlement amounts to be considered complete.
rules.condition: when a delivery transaction is finalized for payout
rules.if_violated: The settlement is rejected and the payout process is halted until discrepancies are resolved
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate compensation and prevents financial disputes between the platform and workers

parameters.name: required_settlement_components
parameters.description: List of mandatory financial fields including costs, fees, taxes, commissions, and net amounts

rules.name: Delivery Verification Mandate
rules.statement: A financial transaction record must be linked to verifiable evidence of delivery before finalizing the settlement status.
rules.condition: when an order is marked as delivered for payment processing
exceptions: Force majeure events documented by the Delivery Partner
rules.if_violated: The settlement status remains 'Pending' and funds are withheld until valid proof is uploaded
rules.rationale: Prevents payment for undelivered goods and ensures integrity of the gig-economy logistics model

parameters.name: acceptable_evidence_types
parameters.description: Types of proof accepted such as GPS coordinates, photo timestamps, or signature logs

rules.name: Historical Earnings Transparency
rules.statement: A Delivery Partner may only view their historical earnings summary if the data is derived from finalized settlement records.
rules.condition: when a Delivery Partner accesses the financial transparency portal
rules.if_violated: Access to the earnings view is denied to prevent unauthorized data manipulation or premature viewing
rules.rationale: Ensures workers see only accurate, finalized financial data to maintain trust and compliance

parameters.name: data_finalization_threshold
parameters.description: The state a transaction must reach (e.g., 'Settled') before earnings data is visible

rules.name: Payout Schedule Adherence
rules.statement: A payout schedule must be generated based on the contractual agreement version active at the time of the transaction.
rules.condition: when calculating the amount due for a specific delivery batch
rules.if_violated: The payout calculation is invalidated and the batch is re-queued for recalculation using the correct contract version
rules.rationale: Ensures financial compliance with the specific commission rates and terms agreed upon at the time of service

parameters.name: active_agreement_version
parameters.description: The specific version of the agreement valid for the transaction date
